# Fonts

Used by the figures rebuilt from the slides (`docs/scripts/build_figures.py`), which are set in the same faces as the paper's figures.

| File | Font | License |
|---|---|---|
| `freesentation-500/600/700.woff2` | Freesentation 5 Medium, 6 SemiBold, 7 Bold, subset to Latin | SIL OFL 1.1, `OFL-Freesentation.txt` |
| `cascadia-code-350.woff2` | Cascadia Code SemiLight (unmodified, release 2407.24) | SIL OFL 1.1, `OFL-CascadiaCode.txt` |
